CREATE TABLE public.bom (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(21, 2), 
	remarks VARCHAR(255), 
	created_by VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	created_date TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_modified_by VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	last_modified_date TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	product_id BIGINT, 
	uom_id BIGINT, 
	status_id BIGINT, 
	prod_mfg_config_id BIGINT, 
	comments VARCHAR(255), 
	info VARCHAR(255), 
	type VARCHAR(255), 
	dispensing_uom_id BIGINT, 
	decimal_precision VARCHAR(255), 
	ref_product_id BIGINT, 
	CONSTRAINT bom_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_bom__dispensing_uom_id FOREIGN KEY(dispensing_uom_id) REFERENCES public.uom (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_bom__prod_mfg_config_id FOREIGN KEY(prod_mfg_config_id) REFERENCES public.product_mfg_config (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_bom__product_id FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES public.product (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_bom__ref_product_id FOREIGN KEY(ref_product_id) REFERENCES public.product (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_bom__status_id FOREIGN KEY(status_id) REFERENCES public.status (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_bom__uom_id FOREIGN KEY(uom_id) REFERENCES public.uom (id)
)
